_comment: Open Images detection AP produced by the TensorFlow Object Detection API (OpenImagesDetectionEvaluator, group_of_weight=1.0), NOT by hotcoco. This is the Challenge detection metric without the non-exhaustive image-level-label filter, which hotcoco does not implement. Consumed by scripts/parity_oid.py. Regenerate with scripts/gen_oid_fixtures.py (needs network access).
